modifiedUpstreamFiles.nuxt.config.ts: Inject public environment/version metadata from the root declarative domain contract, expose contentSource/siteName from GEEK_FORUM_CONTENT_DIR (GEEK_FORUM_SOURCE=demo wins), and set app.baseURL from GEEK_FORUM_BASE_PATH so the static build can be served under the portal domain /forum path; prerender /llms.txt and /t/<id>.md for every seed topic (answered by server/middleware/forum-markdown.ts) so the static build ships them as files; no static head title. Local is not preview, and metadata does not authorize deployment.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/about.vue: Show the owner's preview/production domains and environment/version card; describe the 极客班 read-only snapshot when it is the content source, upstream demo text otherwise.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/categories.vue: Category rows show both cues: category.icon as the TxCardItem icon-class avatar and upstream's TxBadge colour dot in front of the name (title slot), so the upstream 8-dot assertion holds; rows carry role=link; recent-topic TxCellLink hrefs carry app.baseURL.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/c/[slug].vue: Banner keeps upstream TxCardItem + TxStatCard but lays them out with TxFlex: heading beside a two-column TxGrid of stats, wrapping under it on a phone (upstream's #right slot stacked the full-width stat cards into a tall column); the category name is the page h1.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/tag/[slug].vue: Banner keeps upstream TxCardItem + TxStatCard but lays them out with TxFlex: heading beside a two-column TxGrid of stats, wrapping under it on a phone (upstream's #right slot stacked the full-width stat cards into a tall column); the tag is the page h1.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/users.vue: The member TxCellLink href carries app.baseURL (useAppLink); the 角色 cell shows the 极客班 TitleBadge when the user has a title (the forum role badge otherwise), sorts by titleRank then role rank, and is widened to fit 「社区部 · 负责人」. The header text stays 角色 because the upstream directory check asserts it.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/layouts/default.vue: Wrap the page area in LocalSnapshotGate; no business rewrite.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/app.vue: Site name from the content source in the title template; hide the /new command when the snapshot is read-only.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/error.vue: Site name from the content source in the error page title template.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/plugins/persist.client.ts: Skip localStorage hydration and writes entirely in snapshot mode so the real archive never lands in the demo storage.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/ForumHeader.vue: Site name from content source; retains the animated TxTuffLogoStroke component.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/ForumSidebar.vue: Workspace slot is a TxCardItem link with the official 极客班 logo instead of the generic letter chip (decorative image, accessible name = visible site name); the site blurb sits in its description, not subtitle, because the upstream shell check reads the signed-in footer card as the sidebar's only subtitle; fine-tuned font sizes; category rows show the category icon with upstream's TxBadge colour dot on its corner (both cues, upstream dot assertion intact); no 重置示例数据 in snapshot mode.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/composables/useForumNav.ts: Pass category.icon to sidebar nav items; the sidebar pairs that icon with upstream's dotColors colour dot.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/LoginModal.vue: In snapshot mode every 登录 trigger opens a read-only notice instead of the mock member picker.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/PostCard.vue: Wrap Markdown view in an overflow container for mobile table/code scrolling; the copied permalink and the author TxCellLink href carry app.baseURL (useAppLink); the author row shows the 极客班 TitleBadge when the author has a title, the upstream role badge otherwise.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/TopicControls.vue: Guest prompt wording for the read-only snapshot; the share link carries app.baseURL (useAppLink).
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/UserAvatar.vue: Pass the optional avatarUrl (local asset route) to TxAvatar; initials stay the fallback.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/data/types.ts: Optional User.avatarUrl for snapshot avatars (the seed never sets it) and optional User.title (极客班 称号, see app/data/titles.ts); role semantics unchanged.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.uno.config.ts: Safelist the category icons that arrive as snapshot/curation data (the scanner cannot see them) and re-run the config when content/curation.json changes.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.scripts/lib/cdp.mjs: Configurable Chromium executable, unique temporary profiles, own-process-group cleanup instead of broad pkill. Original assertions remain intact.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/u/[username]/index.vue: Profile banner shows the 极客班 TitleBadge (size md) beside the name, in addition to the unchanged forum-role badge.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/data/seed-content.ts: UserSeed.title and the demo 极客班 titles: talex 班长, mika 社区部 · 负责人, yuki 技术部 · 负责人, kai 技术部 · 干事, lin 领航员, six plain members; bruce none. No role changed, so the one-admin/one-moderator seed test and the upstream suites' author/other members (ryan, xiaoyu) are unaffected. Three seed bodies say the same thing without the → arrow character (the owner bans decorative arrows); no topic, title, count or reply changes.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/data/seed.ts: buildUsers copies the optional seed title onto the user (a fresh object per user); consumes no PRNG draws, so every other seeded value is unchanged.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/data/permissions.ts: Adds hasForumCapability(user, capability): admin/moderator by role hold every forum capability as before, anyone else holds what their 极客班 title carries (titleForumCapabilities, mirroring the server catalogue's forum packs). isStaff = forum.post.moderate (edit/delete others' posts, reply in closed topics); pinTopic reads forum.topic.pin and closeTopic reads forum.topic.close. Demo permissions only, not an authorization boundary; every other ForumAction rule is unchanged.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/t/[id].vue: The 话题管理 menu shows when the viewer may pin or close (can('pinTopic') / can('closeTopic')) instead of isStaff, and lists only the items they may use, so a title that carries forum.topic.pin alone (项目部 head) sees 置顶话题 without 关闭话题. Admins and moderators still get both items; the upstream staff pin check is unchanged. Add <link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"> to the topic head, only for topics that have a Markdown file (seed topics, or every topic of the dev snapshot); the post stream is unchanged.
